From plan.md section 2, verbatim:

- alpha: `greeting(name: str | None = None) -> str`, in package `alpha`. With
  no name it returns `hello, demo`. With a name of at most 64 code points it
  returns `hello, <name>`. A longer name raises `ValueError`, whose message
  names the limit, 64.
- beta: `python3 -m beta`, with alpha importable, prints the greeting as its
  first line of standard output, then its existing banner `beta 1.0`.
- Project-level tests are Markdown files `test_R<n>_S<m>_<slug>.md` in
  `changes/add-greeting/tests/`, each with Given, When (one shell command, in
  which `$ALPHA` and `$BETA` are the alpha and beta checkouts of the commit
  set), Then and Fails if.
- Unit suites: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` from the alpha root;
  `PYTHONPATH="$ALPHA" python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` from the beta
  root.

=== changes/add-greeting/tests/test_R1_S1_default_greeting.md
# test_R1_S1_default_greeting

- scenario: R1.S1
- expected_s: 1
- heavy: false

## Given

alpha at the commit set under test, checked out at `$ALPHA`.

## When

    cd "$ALPHA" && python3 -c 'import sys, alpha; sys.stdout.write(alpha.greeting())'

## Then

Standard output is exactly `hello, demo` (11 characters, no trailing
newline), and the exit status is 0.

## Fails if

alpha has no greeting, or its text differs from `hello, demo` by any
character.
=== changes/add-greeting/tests/test_R1_S2_name_too_long.md
# test_R1_S2_name_too_long

- scenario: R1.S2
- expected_s: 1
- heavy: false

## Given

alpha at the commit set under test, checked out at `$ALPHA`, and a name of
65 characters.

## When

    cd "$ALPHA" && python3 -c 'import alpha; alpha.greeting("x" * 65)'

## Then

The exit status is not 0, standard error names the limit, `64`, and
standard output is empty.

## Fails if

alpha greets a 65-character name, or refuses it without naming the limit.

alpha and beta at the commit set under test, checked out at `$ALPHA` and

The first line of standard output is exactly `hello, demo`, within 1 s of

## Fails if

beta prints anything else first, or takes 1 s or more.
